definitions: To continue to have something; to retain possession of.
To continue in a specified condition, position, or course of action.
To store something in a particular place.
To continue to do something; to carry on.
To obey or comply with (a law, promise, etc.).
To prevent or cause to continue in a specified state or position.
examples: She keeps her jewellery in a safe.
The fence will keep the dogs in.
